title: 7 Steps to a Better Decision | Principles of Management Ep 21
description:
How do good managers choose, instead of guessing? Chai Corner now has five outlets and a small head office, and on winter evenings sales drop at all five. Kabir wants hot snacks, Asha wants longer hours and Meena wants a new ginger flavour. In this animated lesson, Ravi learns to follow a process.

You will learn what decision making means (choosing the best option from two or more alternatives) and watch Ravi run all seven steps live: identify the problem, gather information, list the alternatives, evaluate each one, choose the best, implement, and follow up. One month later the numbers show one outlet still needs a fix, so the decision loop starts again. We group the steps into Herbert Simon's three phases (intelligence, design, choice), see the same steps at work today in a hospital, an online shop, a school, a bank and a factory, and look at the human side honestly: a process means fewer blind guesses and clear reasons, but it takes time, good facts cost money, bias still creeps in, and small choices only need a quick rule.

This is Episode 21 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
